from pathlib import Path
import sys,pickle
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'scripts'))
import ability_observation as p
path=p.WORK/'snapshot.pkl'
with path.open('rb') as f: matrix,races=pickle.load(f)
x=matrix.frame
assert matrix.feature_cols==p.columns_from_model()+p.OBSERVATION_COLUMNS
cols=p.OBSERVATION_COLUMNS
valid=x[cols[:2]+['days_since_last']].notna().all(axis=1)
assert (x.loc[valid,cols[1]]>=x.loc[valid,cols[0]]).all()
assert (x.loc[valid,cols[0]]>=x.loc[valid,'days_since_last']).all()
assert (x.loc[valid,'days_since_last']>0).all()
assert x[cols[0]].notna().equals(x['asof_spdfig_count']>=1)
assert x[cols[1]].notna().equals(x['asof_spdfig_count']>=1)
assert x[cols[2]].notna().equals(x['asof_spdfig_count']>=2)
y=x[pd.to_datetime(x.race_date)>=pd.Timestamp('2019-01-01')]
summary={}
for c in cols:
    a=y[c].to_numpy(dtype=float);av=np.isfinite(a)
    exact=[];comparisons=[]
    for bcol in p.columns_from_model():
        if bcol in matrix.categorical_cols: continue
        b=y[bcol].to_numpy(dtype=float); bv=np.isfinite(b); both=av&bv
        same=np.isclose(a[both],b[both],rtol=0,atol=1e-12)
        if np.array_equal(av,bv) and same.all(): exact.append(bcol)
        if both.any(): comparisons.append({'existing_column':bcol,'n_both_valid':int(both.sum()),'same_rate':float(same.mean())})
    assert not exact, (c,exact)
    summary[c]={'n':len(y),'n_valid':int(av.sum()),'coverage':float(av.mean()),'exact_existing_duplicates':exact,'highest_value_agreements':sorted(comparisons,key=lambda z:z['same_rate'],reverse=True)[:5]}
p.write_json(p.SPEC/'evidence/input-audit.json',{'snapshot_sha256':p.digest(path),'audit_method_sha256':p.digest(__file__),'method_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'checks':{'all_age_ordering':True,'count_missingness_matches':True,'no_exact_existing_duplicate_columns':True},'window':['2019-01-01','2026-08-23'],'summaries':summary,'can_adopt':False,'predictive_effect_measured':False})
print(summary)
